newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices fall on overseas trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices fall on overseas trends.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices fell on Wednesday to 1,171/1,172 rupees per quintal from 1,176/1,177 rupees on overseas trends, dealers said.
"New crop arrivals remained low on account of severe cold weather in producing centres but sluggish overseas buying prompted fresh bull liquidation," one dealer said.
New crop arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped to 19/20,000 bags (75 kg each).
Groundnut oil was steady at the reduced level of 340/341 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 40/50 tonnes.
Rajkot spot oil was steady at 515 rupees per 15 kg.
In Bombay, imported palm oil was unchanged at 283/284 rupees per 10 kg for resale purposes and at 284/285 rupees per 10 kg for direct delivery by importers.
The Bombay castor markets will be closed on Thursday for a national holiday to mark the birth centenary of Subhash Chandra Bose, a prominent Indian freedom fighter. The markets reopen on Friday.
